residual_risks: The compact detector ignores bright components outside rows22--61 and outside its area/width/height limits. An undetected, merged or very close obstacle is indistinguishable from clear road and may receive gas0.36.
A bend not yet visible in sampled rows30--54 can be classified straight. Higher gas changes future observations, so static same-input parity cannot prove trajectory-level safety.

The five-frame longitudinal obstacle miss behavior remains conservative and clear-curve gas is unchanged. These may still dominate the eight-to-nine seconds of low-speed exposure, but relaxing either without paired driving evidence is unsafe.
No authorized dynamic run measured completion, collisions, off-track behavior, physical speed or lap time. The candidate remains INCOMPARABLE.
SOTA.md, RESULTS.md, COMPETITION_INFO.md, RESTRICTIONs.md and report.pdf remain absent, so environment evaluation, promotion and submission remain blocked.
